sources.title: Embassy of the Republic of Sudan -- Entry Visa: Business/Work/Humanitarian visa, USD 154, up to 10 working days processing, requires a sponsorship letter detailing the work type and duration; separate diplomatic/official visa category also listed

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Sudan). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- tier-1 official diplomatic mission sourced. IMPORTANT POLITICAL CONTEXT, DISCLOSED HERE AND REPEATED ACROSS EVERY SUDAN FILE IN THIS BUILD: Sudan has been in an active civil war since April 2023 between the Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF) and the Rapid Support Forces (RSF). Khartoum, the capital, was a war zone for an extended period; the internationally-recognized government reportedly returned to Khartoum in January 2026, but as of an April 2026 Al Jazeera report the two sides remained in a 'military impasse,' and fighting continued elsewhere (e.g. a Blue Nile campaign as of May 2026). The RSF has separately declared a rival parallel administration in territory it controls. This embassy site represents the internationally-recognized, SAF-aligned government -- routes built here reflect that government's stated rules, which may be unenforceable, inapplicable, or simply inoperative in RSF-held or contested territory. Sudan is simultaneously the site of what is widely described as the world's largest displacement crisis (both internal displacement and cross-border refugee flight). STRUCTURAL FINDING: no distinct pure-tourism visa category was located -- every entry-visa category found bundles business, work, and humanitarian purposes together under one sponsorship-letter-gated process, suggesting Sudan's visa system is not currently structured around routine leisure travel. work_rights is 'restricted' since the visa is purpose-bound to the sponsored activity, not a general employment authorization -- no separate ordinary work-permit process distinct from this entry visa was located in this build.
